title: Revisiting the Effects of Sample Preparation on EBSD Performance in the Era of Forward Model Indexing
content: Proper sample preparation is required to obtain quality EBSD orientation measurements. Earlier works examined the effects of different stages of mechanical preparation on EBSD pattern quality metrics and indexing success rate performance [1,2]. These results were obtained using indexing algorithms utilizing the Hough transform for diffraction band detection. Recently, a new method of indexing, called Forward Model indexing, has been developed [3].
